subject: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness

Team — quick ask. HarborTrust (deal HT-4721) just confirmed strong purchase intent pending two capability items that are blockers in legal and their SOC team. This is a high-velocity opportunity: forecasted ARR $1.2M, expected PO in early Feb if we can commit to a pilot deliverable and SLOs.

Top asks from the customer (they explicitly called these contract gating):
- Tenant-level audit export (CSV/JSON) with user-identity mapping and immutable timestamped logs (retention policy configurable).
- Ability to generate on-prem snapshot exports or a supported private VPC snapshot workflow for disaster recovery (they prefer air-gapped option, but will accept CMK + private VPC for pilot).
- Per-route SLA (99.9) and a documented rollback/fallback for degraded model variants.

Attachments: HarborTrust_MVP_requirements.xlsx (attached) — I mapped the customer asks to what they consider M0 vs M1. Also attaching a short SOW draft they signed off on in principle.

Asking Product/Eng: can we scope a minimal pilot (deliverable = audit export + retention controls + documented fallback) that we can commit to by Mar 15? If full on-prem snapshots are heavy, is there a staged path? We need a short go/no-go and rough effort estimate by EOD Monday (Jan 16) so I can surface to Legal and the customer.

Why now: HarborTrust has a security council meeting on Feb 6; if we aren’t on the shortlist by then they will look at alternatives.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness

Thanks Sean — good summary. A few clarifying Qs so we can size this properly: 
1) Audit exports: do they need real-time stream (Kafka/Syslog) or batched exports (daily/ hourly CSV)? The complexity differs (streaming is heavier).
2) Retention policy: must it be configurable per-tenant via API, or is a per-account setting sufficient for the pilot?
3) Snapshot/on-prem: is customer expecting a fully managed on-prem installer, or is a one-off snapshot export mechanism acceptable?

Initial read: architecturally we can deliver a "MVP audit export + retention controls" as a staged feature, but on-prem snapshot tooling (installable on customer infra) is a bigger effort (infra packaging, HSM/KMS integration, restore tooling). Rough ballpark: audit export + retention controls — 3–4 engineer-weeks + 1 security review; on-prem snapshot full support — likely 8–12 engineer-weeks and CI/packaging work.

Risks/constraints:
- Q1 roadmap is already committed for two infra spikes; earliest non-blocking lane for new work is mid-February.
- We need Security to sign off on data export formats and key management. Please loop them in ASAP.

Action items for sizing:
- Sean: confirm real-time vs batch export preference and acceptance criteria (examples of CSV fields).
- Jasmine: confirm whether HarborTrust will accept staged deliverables and if they can provide an infra contact for snapshot validation.

If these align, I can draft a scoped plan and estimate for Product to sign off.

—Jordan
Senior PM, Inference Platform
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@harbortrust.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness

Looping in the customer contact — Alyssa (HarborTrust) will validate acceptance criteria and can provide an infra engineer for snapshot validation. Alyssa — HarborTrust is willing to accept a staged approach given time constraints:
- Stage 1 (pilot): batched tenant-level audit exports (hourly), configurable retention (30/90/365 days), and a fallback doc for model variant rollbacks.
- Stage 2: private VPC + CMK for pilot; on-prem installer / snapshot tooling as a commercial add-on (HarborTrust willing to cost-share engineering for M1).

Alyssa, can you confirm the infra contact for snapshot tests and whether the security council can accept hourly batched exports for the pilot? I can attach the SOW slide deck (HarborTrust_SOW_slide.pdf) that outlines their preferences.

Note: HarborTrust's procurement is comfortable with a pilot acceptance window (30 days) and will sign a pilot addendum that includes an engineering cost-share. That makes a staging approach workable.

—Jasmine
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness

Appreciate the fast turnaround — HarborsTrust is strategic for our finance vertical coverage so I'm supportive of a prioritized lane if we can get clear acceptance criteria and a narrowly-scoped M0 that Product signs off on.

Two asks from sales leadership:
- Can Product produce a 1-page gating doc ("what we will deliver for pilot, acceptance test, rollback plan") by Jan 17? I will escalate to SVP if we need additional runway.
- Product must list exact SLOs and what operational support looks like (pager on-call? runbooks?). Legal procurement needs that for PO.

If Product can commit to a scoped pilot for Mar 15 delivery (M0 = hourly audit export + retention + fallback doc + route-level SLA definition), we will push the customer to sign immediately and close the PO.

—Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborTrust: request to prioritize tenant audit & pilot readiness

Thanks — this is clear and actionable. Proposed plan and ask of Eng/Product:

Scope (M0 pilot deliverable):
- Hourly tenant-level audit export (CSV + JSON sample) including user-id, action, model_id, request_id, timestamp (immutable)
- Retention controls exposed via API (30/90/365 days) and one UI toggle for CS during pilot
- Fallback doc for model variant downgrade and per-route SLA definition (documented SLOs and fallback routing)

Acceptance criteria (to include in gating doc):
- HarborTrust can request and receive audit exports for any tenant within 60 minutes of request
- Exports validated against provided sample schema and test dataset by HarborTrust infra contact
- Documented rollback plan tested in staging runbook

Timeline:
- Week 1–2: 2-week scoping + security review (we will allocate an engineer and a PM for scoping)
- Week 3–6: Implementation sprint(s) for audit export + retention APIs (target delivery Mar 15 for pilot rollout)
- Parallel: Security will validate export format and KMS plan in week 2–3

Blockers & assumptions:
- This plan assumes batched/hourly exports are acceptable for pilot (not real-time streaming).
- On-prem snapshot tooling deferred to M1 unless HarborTrust funds cost-share (we will document this in SOW).

Next steps: Jordan — please produce a 1-page scoping doc + effort estimate (red/amber/green) by Monday Jan 16. Sean/Jasmine — provide the final sample export schema and confirm HarborTrust infra contact (Alyssa listed above). I will present the gating doc to Product Leadership on Jan 18.

Irene Choi
Director, Product — Inference Platform
irene_choi@redwood.com
